query: WITH aggregate_heads AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (tenant_id, aggregate_id) id FROM public.outbox WHERE dispatched_at IS NULL AND attempts < $3 AND aggregate_id IS NOT NULL AND (last_error IS NULL OR last_error <> $4) ORDER BY tenant_id, aggregate_id, id ) SELECT candidate.id, candidate.tenant_id, candidate.attempts, candidate.event_type, candidate.aggregate_id, candidate.payload, candidate.occurred_at FROM public.outbox AS candidate WHERE candidate.dispatched_at IS NULL AND candidate.attempts < $3 AND (candidate.last_error IS NULL OR CASE WHEN candidate.last_error ~ '^ritma-retry-v1:[0-9]+:handler_failed$' THEN split_part(candidate.last_error, ':', 2)::bigint <= $2 ELSE false END) AND (candidate.aggregate_id IS NULL OR candidate.id IN ( SELECT id FROM aggregate_heads )) ORDER BY candidate.id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF candidate SKIP LOCKED
